message: 押しかけ古女房

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, let's get this started, darling!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? Why are you in front of my house? And what do you mean by 'get started'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Spring cleaning, obviously.」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it a little early for year-end cleaning?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not talking about some annual tradition! I'm here to check if you're actually living properly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, your aunt and uncle asked me to do this. I'm your personal supervisor, Synn.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... As long as you keep hiding behind excuses, you're gonna stay stuck in place, y'know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up!」

name: Synn
message: 「The front door's unlocked, so you can just come right in, you know? Come on inside, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-Excuse me for intruding.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Are you nervous?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I am not!」
Nanaka and I start cleaning around the kitchen first.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, doing housework really helps clear your mind.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This spot is... all good!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I get it now, Nanaka. Thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This spot is... clear too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though nothing with the Demons has been resolved yet, I let my guard down after KiraFes succeeded.」

name: Synn
message: 「I need to clear away distractions and rest my head so I can switch gears.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why we're doing a big cleaning, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?! Ah... y-yeah, that's right! Ta-hahahaha!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Spinning things in such a painfully charitable way that it corners an obvious snooper like Soba mentally--truly worthy of Lord Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「P-Paqy, what are you talking about?」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Did a single earring get left behind? Is there a lipstick message written on the mirror?'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gulp」

name: Paqy
message: 「Any ingredients Master Synn can't afford? Any seasonings lying around that he wouldn't know how to use?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Gulp」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way, I just came here to clean! Like this--wipe, wipe, wipe~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, ahh!? There's a long hair on the floor...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And it smells sweet... Whose is it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's mine? I heard hair can still grow even after it falls out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew」

name: Paqy
message: 「Those flawless cuticles belong to an angel, y'know? Proof she's eating good food every single day.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn's malnourished, so his hair's all dry and straw-like.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's mean, you don't have to state the facts.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Lolo-chan, seriously!? Well, that's unexpected!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on... This is Synn's bathroom... Don't tell me--no way, did you?!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Did I what? Lolotte's hair probably just fell out when we all had hot pot together the other day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Aha, hahaha... Well, duh. There's no way Synn could ever pull off something like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, Synn, that welcome party was ages ago. Clean your place properly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tea after hard work sure hits the spot... So relaxing, haaa...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for cleaning. Want a refill on your tea?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nah, I already had three cups, so I'm good. Thanks for the tea.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bwaaaah... A tatami room bathed in sunlight on a bright, clear afternoon...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fwaaah... When we were little, this was always naptime, wasn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we used to lie around together at my place or yours.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I really feel like passing out right now. Not that I can, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why can't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why, you ask... Well, that's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, ahh!? There's a long hair on the floor...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, it smells like yakisoba... Whose is that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yours, obviously.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haha, hahahahaha!」
In the end, Nanaka didn't take a nap; she checked over my living habits and went home.
Maybe because I cleaned up, the sunlight streaming into the room feels brighter than usual.
I probably won't be able to sleep tonight, but I think I'll take a nap for the first time in a while.
